definitions.oa_share_grouped: oa/(oa+nonoa); missing when denominator is zero
definitions.oa_share_profile: oa/works; missing when denominator is zero

quantile_rule: Linear interpolation at (N-1)*p on ascending values.
privacy: Distributions without direct identifiers, not guaranteed anonymous. Bottom three replaced by fourth and top three by fourth from top when N >= 7. Shares rounded to 2 decimals. Exact local ranking benchmark is unchanged. Public ranks may differ, especially at extremes and rounded ties.
